subject: [video] WP05 READY (stub + TSan green; real encoder path armed)
body: WP05 complete for its first pass. Command: bash gpu/video/vt/test_avc_vt/run_tests.sh -> last line: N2TEST WP05 PASS 706/706 (353 checks under ASan+UBSan against stub_n2avc, 353 under TSan with two sessions on two threads). iOS: vt/n2avc_vt.c compiles for arm64-apple-ios16.0 with zero warnings. STATUS.json is in gpu/video/vt/test_avc_vt/ with not_done and 12 known_risks (ownership/re-entrancy/type-strings are the big ones the fake cannot prove). The real-encoder case (10 x 176x144, AVCC->Annex B, ffmpeg must decode exactly 10 pictures) is compiled into the same test and run_tests.sh runs it automatically once gpu/video/avc/*.c exists and builds; it has not run yet because avc/ is absent. Blockers reported to WP01: build_ios.sh cannot link the full plug-in until avc/ exists (five n2avc_* internal symbols), and sdk/symbols.txt lacks ___error for n2vt_log.c. I stay available for lead review and will rerun the real path when WP03 announces avc/.
